hidden_risks.title: Critical Path Delay in Distributed Lock Manager Threatening Client Executive Demo
hidden_risks.root_cause: PR #11 (Distributed Lock Manager) assigned to dev_01 is delayed by review refactoring (rev_13, rev_14). This directly blocks Issue #11, which blocks Issue #14 (E2E Failover Validation), which in turn blocks Staging Deployment (dep_01), pushing completion past the Client Executive Demo deadline (dl_03 on 2026-09-04 12:00:00Z).
hidden_risks.expected_impact: Staging cluster rollout and end-to-end validation will slip by 3-4 days beyond the scheduled window, leaving less than 24 hours for live testing before the executive client demo.
hidden_risks.recommended_action: Prioritize code review resolution on PR #11, assign dev_02 to assist dev_01 with lock lease edge cases, and run pre-validation testing using mock lock managers.

hidden_risks.title: Single Point of Failure and High Workload Contention on Architect Alex Chen (dev_01)
hidden_risks.root_cause: dev_01 (Alex Chen) is assigned 7 open issues, authored 4 active PRs, and is designated sole reviewer for 6 PRs across the team. Total assigned workload exceeds available capacity by 280%, creating a major bottleneck for critical path reviews and PR merges.
hidden_risks.expected_impact: Team review latency increases exponentially; pull requests sit open for multiple days awaiting dev_01 approval; critical milestones ms_02 and ms_03 experience secondary cumulative delays.
hidden_risks.recommended_action: Reassign PR review responsibilities (pr_09, pr_12) to dev_04 and dev_02; reassign Issue #19 (TLS/RBAC) to dev_06; pair dev_02 with dev_01 on Raft consensus implementation.

hidden_risks.title: Unresolved DB Schema Breaking Change in PR #7 Threatening Scheduled Production DB Upgrade
hidden_risks.root_cause: Deployment dep_02 (Production DB Engine Upgrade) is scheduled for 2026-08-28. It relies on Issue #9 and PR #7 (Schema Migration Tooling v2). PR #7 drops the events_v1 table directly without backward compatibility and has unaddressed changes_requested status (rev_09) since 2026-08-16.
hidden_risks.expected_impact: Executing dep_02 with unmerged or flawed migration scripts will cause database schema corruption or runtime breakdown for downstream query services.
hidden_risks.recommended_action: Hold deployment dep_02 until PR #7 addresses rev_09 feedback by introducing a dual-read SQL compatibility view, or delay dep_02 until post-v1.0-beta rollout.

false_positive.title: Stale Open PR #4 (Legacy REST V1 Adapter) Suspected of Blocking GraphQL Gateway Migration
false_positive.why_it_looks_dangerous: PR #4 (Legacy REST V1 Adapter) has been open for 18 days with 5 merge conflicts, and Issue #4 was historically recorded as a dependency (dep_rel_17) for Issue #10 (GraphQL API Gateway Migration). An automated scanner might flag PR #4 as a stale blocker for GraphQL migration.
false_positive.why_it_is_safe: PR #10 (GraphQL Native Resolver Engine) was already completed and merged into main on 2026-08-15 via commit_22. Commit_22 removed all legacy REST v1 invocation points in router.go, completely decoupling Issue #10 from Issue #4. PR #4 is an unmerged tech-debt item and does not block any release path.
